notes:
POC goals and constraints (shorthand):
- primary goal: agent assist + accurate citations (support reps must surface doc links in reply)
- secondary: nightly vector reindex + ticket summarization for triage
- workload: ~30k active agents, bursts during product launches (historic peak ~6x baseline)
- latency SLOs: agent-assist tail p95 < 200ms for generate+retrieve; prefer <150ms for typical flows
- throughput: avg 400 qps for assist inference, peak 2500 qps during spikes; embeddings pipeline must handle 50k docs/hr ingestion overnight
- cost sensitivity: mid-high — willing to trade some cost for reliability and citations; want optimizer guidance
- model preference: open models preferred for auditability but will consider Redwood-verified quantized variants; want ability to fallback to smaller model family during overloads
- retrieval: multi-source RAG across Zendesk, Confluence, S3 attachments, and ephemeral Slack threads; must support provenance (doc id + anchor + timestamp)
- freshness needs: legal/KB updates applied daily; product known-issues must be available within 10 minutes of code deploy (near real-time streaming updates for certain namespaces)
- hallucination tolerance: zero for legal/financial replies — must show exact citation with sentence-level anchors; "can't risk hallucinations with legal content" (quote from Head of Legal)
poc_details: Data: sample 1.2M tickets (Zendesk), 3M KB pages (Confluence + S3 attachments), Slack export (last 90d)
Success metrics: citation precision > 92% on benchmark promptset, summary ROUGE-L baseline x2 improvement, tail latency p95 < 200ms during 3x synthetic spike
Technical asks: vector DB options (managed vs bring-your-own), incremental reindex API, per-namespace freshness TTLs, sentence-level provenance
Operational asks: canary rollout, automatic fallback to cheaper model variant on degraded infra, per-customer routing by residency
integration_notes: Primary connectors: Zendesk (ticket bodies + attachments), Confluence (KB pages), S3 bucket of historical articles, Slack excerpts for contextual threads
Auth: must support SAML SSO for admin portal, token rotation via KMS, audit logs retained 2 years
Privacy: ability to redact PII at ingestion and to configure retention policies per namespace
Indexing: incremental streaming preferred for hot namespaces (product known-issues), nightly full reindex for rest
Citations: require link + surrounding sentence + confidence score; prefer deterministic snippet extraction over model hallucination
commercial_notes: Estimated ARR in range given; procurement asks for term discounts and SLA credits for Black Friday-like events. Procurement flagged data-residency SLA as gating. Legal requested DPA + breach notification timing (<=72h).
